title: French bombing of the Greenpeace boat in Auckland Harbor
summary: Ross Coulthart tells of French bombing of the Greenpeace boat in Auckland Harbor, about 1985 at Auckland Harbor, New Zealand, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: was blown up by the DGSE, French intelligence, in an intelligence operation slap-bang in the middle of Auckland Harbor.

plain: An Australian journalist, Ross Coulthart, recalls how a boat belonging to Greenpeace, the environmental campaign group, was blown up in Auckland Harbour, New Zealand, in 1985. He says it was done by the DGSE, France's foreign intelligence service, as a covert operation right in the middle of the harbour. He tells it as an example of what governments and their spy agencies are willing to do in secret.
